name: Either Way
tagline: Even the people you've ruled against trust you. Especially them.

names_note: *Either Way* (all three, round 5: Hester's pick; Wren moved from *By Its Name*, Tomás from *No Favourites*), over *Heard Out* and *Same Answer*. No crossing: picks held until round 5. The phrase appears in the text of 11 pours but is free as a name.
open_items: **Gluten edge:** the barley malt syrup puts the 1908 definition (malt in every whisky, whatever the still) in the glass, so the pour carries `contains: [gluten]` and isn't veto-free. Tomás reads Robin's 'no new vetoes' as no new veto categories (gluten is an existing one) and notes the Ruler family keeps seven veto-free pours. A proven veto-free fallback is in the draft's Checks (switch without a room), but its y4 hasn't been audited (Hester).
